tourbrain.name: TourBrain
tourbrain.tagline: booking and tours platform for local providers.

bluereef.name: Blue Reef Divers
bluereef.tagline: scuba diving and snorkeling site in Cozumel.
bluereef.detail: tour catalog, deposit-based bookings via PayPal. Next.js, Tailwind.

gnga.tagline: Web3 protocol with its own conversational bot (Nibbles).
gnga.detail: orchestrated via n8n + self-hosted AI, no third-party lock-in.

ponexo.name: Ponexo
ponexo.tagline: AI-powered business diagnosis for real companies.
ponexo.detail: guided questionnaire, action plan by email, and your own dashboard with a Marketing Score.

tourquesa.tagline: booking platform for tours in the Mexican Caribbean.
tourquesa.detail: tour catalog, deposit-based bookings via Stripe. Next.js, Supabase, Stripe.
